population_one_line: Adult and neonatal patients with Gram-negative catheter-related BSI (cases) vs other CRBSI (controls), single center Spain
ttp_reported: Mean TTP adults GN-CRBSI 10.3+/-7.4h vs other CRBSI 19.5+/-16.7h; mortality table reports mean TTP 18.5+/-25h dead vs 9+/-6.7h alive (p=0.008)
outcome_one_line: Mortality (16 deaths/81 cases); TTP differed by mortality on univariate t-test only; multivariable mortality model did NOT include TTP (P. aeruginosa, surgery, complicated bacteremia were the OR/CI factors). TTP was the OUTCOME variable predicted by GN etiology (aOR 4.3 for shorter TTP), not the predictor of clinical outcome
notes: TTP analyzed as a predictor of GN-CRBSI vs non-GN-CRBSI, not as predictor of mortality with OR/HR/CI. Mortality table shows mean TTP difference (univariate) but no quantitative TTP->mortality association reported.

population_one_line: Patients with ascites cultures screened for spontaneous bacterial peritonitis, single center Houston (pre/post intervention)
ttp_reported: Not measured; study examines ascites culture positivity yield with direct inoculation into BC bottles
outcome_one_line: Ascites culture positivity (microbiology yield), not a clinical outcome in BSI
notes: Population is SBP/ascites cultures, not bloodstream infection. Excluded as not_bsi.

population_one_line: Adults with S. aureus bloodstream infection at one US academic hospital, pre vs post antimicrobial stewardship intervention
outcome_one_line: Adherence to standard practices, duration of bacteremia (not TTP), mortality, LOS, relapse compared pre/post intervention
notes: Quality improvement / stewardship intervention study; no TTP variable measured or analyzed.

population_one_line: Editorial commentary on Chavez et al. study of BacT/Alert VIRTUO blood culture system
ttp_reported: Discusses TTP conceptually but reports no original data
outcome_one_line: No original outcome data; commentary only

population_one_line: Adults with MSSA bacteraemia receiving empirical flucloxacillin, cefuroxime or ceftriaxone, multicentre Netherlands (IDISA)
ttp_reported: Not measured; only duration of bacteraemia (days between positive and negative BC) is reported
outcome_one_line: Duration of bacteraemia (days) and 30-day SAB-related mortality compared between empirical beta-lactam groups (HR with CI)
notes: TTP only appears in a cited reference, not measured or analyzed in this study. Duration of bacteraemia is a different exposure.

population_one_line: Adults with persistent/high-grade MRSA bacteremia receiving ceftaroline combination therapy, single center retrospective
ttp_reported: Not reported; time to bacteremia clearance is reported but not TTP
outcome_one_line: 30-day mortality, microbiological relapse, time to bacteremia clearance compared by duration of ceftaroline after clearance
notes: Conference poster abstract (IDWeek 2023, OFID supplement) - single-page abstract, wrong_design. Also no TTP.

population_one_line: Critically ill ICU adults with suspected catheter-related BSI, randomized to DTP-based vs standard catheter-removal management; 16-bed ICU Spain
ttp_reported: Differential TTP (DTP) >=120 min used to diagnose CR-BSI; values not analyzed against clinical outcomes
outcome_one_line: Number of catheter removals; inflammatory parameters (CRP, WBC, temperature) and in-hospital mortality compared between management groups, NOT by TTP value
notes: PDF file Cabello2010.txt actually contains Sabatier et al 2014 (Med Intensiva). Trial compares diagnostic strategies; DTP is used as a binary threshold for management decision; no quantitative TTP->clinical-outcome association is reported.

population_one_line: Hospitalized adults with MRSA bloodstream infection, vancomycin alone vs vancomycin+cefazolin combination, Detroit Medical Center 2006-2021
ttp_reported: Not reported; duration of bacteremia reported (49 vs 62 h) but not TTP
outcome_one_line: 30-day mortality (aOR 0.31, 95% CI 0.11-0.93 for VAN+CFZ); duration of bacteremia
notes: Single-page IDWeek 2023 conference abstract (OFID supplement). Exclude as wrong_design (abstract only). Also no TTP measure.

population_one_line: Adults with MRSA bloodstream infection treated with vancomycin alone vs vancomycin+empirical beta-lactam, 5 US hospitals 2010-2014 (REACH-ID)
ttp_reported: Not measured; duration of bacteremia reported (days to first negative BC)
outcome_one_line: Composite clinical failure (30-day mortality, persistent bacteremia, relapse, regimen change): COMBO aOR 0.237 (0.057-0.982); duration of bacteremia 3 vs 4 days
notes: No mention of time-to-positivity anywhere in text; only duration-of-bacteremia exposure analyzed.

population_one_line: Patients with gram-positive coccus bacteremia (MSSA 36, CoNS 28, MRSA 19), Taiwan single center, comparing PCR vs conventional ID
ttp_reported: TTP <20h used as an inclusion criterion only; not analyzed as a continuous exposure or against outcomes
outcome_one_line: 30-day mortality 15% (PCR) vs 10% (control); MRSA borderline associated with mortality (p=0.06); PCR did not affect outcome
notes: Conference abstract from APSIC 2015 (single column abstract). Exclude as wrong_design. TTP used only as eligibility filter, no quantitative TTP->outcome analysis.
